title: Schedule a working-day deadline
Display an instant in another timezone
code:
import { formatDate } from '@mfuon2/chrono-utilz';
console.log(formatDate(new Date('2025-01-15T12:00:00Z'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss', 'America/New_York'));

title: Clamp arithmetic to the end of a month
Generate weekly occurrences
code:
import { generateRecurringDates, formatDate } from '@mfuon2/chrono-utilz';
console.log(generateRecurringDates('2025-01-01', {pattern: 'weekly', maxOccurrences: 3}).map(d => formatDate(d)).join(', '));

title: Resolve a relative expression from a fixed date
code:
import { parseNaturalLanguage, formatDate } from '@mfuon2/chrono-utilz';
console.log(formatDate(parseNaturalLanguage('next friday', {baseDate: new Date(2025, 0, 15)})));

title: Format custom tokens and literal text
code:
import { formatCustom } from '@mfuon2/chrono-utilz';
console.log(formatCustom(new Date(2025, 0, 15), 'MMMM [day] Do, YYYY'));
